**Logs**
In the app: Settings › Debug › Share › Logs (in Portuguese: Ajustes › Depuração › Compartilhar › Registros; in Spanish: Ajustes › Depuración › Compartir › Registros).
Do not choose "With recordings (large)" unless asked. Say the time of the problem, so it can be found in the log.

**Before attaching a log, recording or photo**
They can contain places you went, Wi-Fi names, phone numbers or contact names. Please read through them and cut out
anything private first. A short description is better than a log you are not sure about.
